subject: SOC 2: Clarify bridge letter applicability for Hosted → Dedicated migration
messages:
From: Procurement <procurement@novacore.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Novacore Security <security@novacore.com>, AuditorOps <audits@auditfirm.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence request — Hosted to Dedicated migration window

Hi Neha / Marissa,

We are preparing for our vendor risk review and our auditor (AuditorOps) asked for clarification on the SOC 2 Type II coverage for our workloads that migrated from Redwood Hosted to a Dedicated pool in early July. Specifically:

- Please confirm the last SOC 2 audit period covered by your Type II report (dates).
- If the customer’s tenant was on Hosted during the audit window but moved to Dedicated after the window closed, can Redwood provide a bridge letter attesting controls coverage for the migration period and the date range it would cover?
- What artifacts/evidence would you provide with the bridge letter (e.g., deployment manifests, routing logs, access logs)?

We'd like to close this by next week to keep our procurement timeline on track.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Senior Procurement Manager — Novacore
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@novacore.com>, AuditorOps <audits@auditfirm.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — Hosted to Dedicated migration window

Hi Maya / AuditorOps,

Thanks for the note — happy to clarify. Short answers up front:

- Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31.
- Redwood can provide a bridge letter that (1) confirms the controls in-scope for Hosted remained in place during the transition window and (2) documents the exact dates of the tenant migration from Hosted → Dedicated. The bridge letter is limited to attesting controls continuity — it does not replace a future SOC 2 report that includes Dedicated pools in scope.
- Typical supporting artifacts: deployment manifest, tenant timeline (timestamps of routing/assignment), routing/access logs for the tenant, and signed attestation from our infra ops lead.

Jonas / Karthik — can you pull the tenant timeline and routing logs for tenant novacore-123 and confirm the Dedicated pool onboarding date? I will draft a bridge letter template once we have dates and evidence files to reference.

Deliverable asks for Novacore: 1) confirm the exact tenant id you saw in your environment, 2) any internal names for the migration event, and 3) acceptance that a bridge letter plus the artifacts above satisfies your auditor.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novacore.com>, AuditorOps <audits@auditfirm.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — Hosted to Dedicated migration window

Hi all,

I pulled the records for tenant id novacore-123 (internal id). Summary:

- Tenant remained on Hosted endpoints through 2026-07-11 23:58:46 UTC.
- Dedicated pool provisioning completed and tenant routing changed on 2026-07-12 03:12:09 UTC (US-west region).
- There were no maintenance windows or control changes in the week leading up to the migration; authentication and audit logging remained enabled.

Attached are extracts:
- tenant-timeline-export-20260719.csv (timestamps for tenant events)
- routing-log-20260701-20260715.csv (edge → runtime routing records)
- deployment-manifest-novacore-20260630.pdf (manifest used for Dedicated onboarding)

Notes on scope: because the SOC2 Type II report audit period ended 2026-03-31, the Dedicated pool onboarding occurred after that audit window. A bridge letter can attest that controls were continuously applied to the tenant during 2026-07-11 → 2026-07-12 migration and can reference the attached artifacts.

If AuditorOps needs specific control language (e.g., CC6/CC7 mapping) called out in the letter, say so and we will mark it up.

Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: AuditorOps <audits@auditfirm.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novacore.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — Hosted to Dedicated migration window

Thanks Jonas / Neha — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from the audit team:

1) For the bridge letter we will need: precise date range for the attestation (we generally accept a start = last day of the SOC 2 audit period + 1, end = the date the Dedicated pool came online, OR a narrower period that covers the actual change window). Please propose language that states controls remained in effect and whether any configuration drift occurred during the change.

2) Please include the following artifacts (PDFs preferred where possible): deployment manifest, system access list for the change window, routing logs (as CSV is fine), and a signed statement from a Redwood officer responsible for operations.

3) We may ask for a short sampling of authentication logs (2–3 events) around the migration time to validate logging continuity.

If you can provide a draft bridge letter by EOD tomorrow we can review and return any markup.

—Alex Kern
Senior Manager, AuditorOps
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: AuditorOps <audits@auditfirm.com>, Procurement <procurement@novacore.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — Hosted to Dedicated migration window (Draft bridge letter & next steps)

Alex / Maya,

Attached: draft bridge letter (short form) and the artifacts Jonas referenced. Highlights:

- Proposed attestation period: 2026-04-01 through 2026-07-12 (we chose 2026-04-01 as the day after the SOC 2 Type II audit window closed to provide a conservative coverage window; we are willing to narrow this to 2026-07-11 -> 2026-07-12 if you prefer a minimal window).
- Controls statement: confirms that controls in-scope for Hosted (access controls, logging, change management, monitoring) were maintained during the migration and that no control-affecting configuration drift was detected in our post-change review.
- Attached artifacts: tenant-timeline-export-20260719.csv, routing-log-20260701-20260715.csv, deployment-manifest-novacore-20260630.pdf. We have redacted internal hostnames where appropriate.

Next steps:
- AuditorOps to review the draft and propose any control-specific language changes by EOD tomorrow.
- Novacore to confirm acceptance of the proposed period (2026-04-01 — 2026-07-12) or request the minimal change-window range.
- Once accepted, I will coordinate signatures and provide a final PDF and the referenced artifacts via our secure share link.

Thanks — aiming to keep this short so Novacore's procurement doesn't block on this.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
